name: Norukasoruka
source:
"I want you to help me find the Oni"
So tells me the Tengu in the shrine I wandered to.

December, 22th.
Winter solstice.
The day where the shadows are longer.

The shadow inhabitants start to move.
A nocturnal game of tag.

"If you can find the Oni, I'll grant you one wish"
The main character, Shiawa, who wants to get happiness, starts to run in the long night...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090204034644/http://nfs.boo.jp/bouquet/norukasoruka/]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
“我希望你帮忙找出鬼。”
我误入一座神社后，那里的天狗如此对我说道。

12月22日。
冬至。
影子变得更长的日子。

栖身于影子中的居民开始行动。
一场在黑夜中进行的捉迷藏。

“如果你能找出鬼，我就实现你一个愿望。”
渴望获得幸福的主人公Shiawa，就这样在漫漫长夜中奔跑起来…

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090204034644/http://nfs.boo.jp/bouquet/norukasoruka/]官方网站[/url]]
